items.title: A metabolic Seifert matrix has Fox–Milnor factorization

references.title: Charles Livingston, A Survey of Classical Knot Concordance
references.locator: §3.3, printed p. 326: a metabolic Seifert form has Alexander determinant equal up to a Laurent unit to f(t)f(t^{-1}).

references.title: Anthony Conway, The Levine–Tristram Signature: A Survey

items.statement:
Let $g$ be a nonnegative integer, let $L$ be a free abelian group of rank $2g$, and let $V:L\times L\to\mathbb Z$ be a bilinear form whose matrix in an integral basis satisfies $\det(V-V^T)=\pm1$. Let $M\subseteq L$ be a direct summand of rank $g$ such that $V(x,y)=0$ for every $x,y\in M$. Write $d_V(t)=\det(V-tV^T)$, using the empty determinant $1$ when $g=0$. Then there is a polynomial $f(t)\in\mathbb Z[t]$ such that

$$d_V(t)=t^g f(t)f(t^{-1}).$$

In the Laurent polynomial ring, define $p\doteq q$ to mean $p=\pm t^kq$ for some integer $k$. Thus $d_V(t)\doteq f(t)f(t^{-1})$.

items.title: Locally flat sliceness implies Fox–Milnor factorization

references.title: Ralph H. Fox and John W. Milnor, Singularities of 2-spheres in 4-space and cobordism of knots
Charles Livingston, A Survey of Classical Knot Concordance
references.locator: §2.2, Theorem 2.6, printed p. 323, and §3.3, printed p. 326.

items.statement: Assume the full Axiom of Choice. Let $K\subset S^3$ be a smooth oriented knot, let $F\subset S^3$ be a connected compact smooth oriented Seifert surface of genus $g$, and let $V$ be its positive-push Seifert matrix, with entries $V_{ij}=\operatorname{lk}(a_i^+,a_j)$ in an ordered integral basis of $H_1(F;\mathbb Z)$. Let $\Delta_K(t)$ be the Alexander polynomial normalized by $\Delta_K(t)\doteq\det(V-tV^T)$, where $p\doteq q$ means $p=\pm t^kq$ for some $k\in\mathbb Z$. If the integral Seifert lattice is metabolic, then there is an $f(t)\in\mathbb Z[t]$ such that $\Delta_K(t)\doteq f(t)f(t^{-1})$. The same factorization is necessary if $K$ bounds a locally flat properly embedded disk in the standard four-ball $B^4$. This is a necessary condition for either algebraic or locally flat sliceness, not a sufficient condition. The factorization concerns the Alexander polynomial $\Delta_K$, not the separate knot-normalized fraction $D_K(t)=\Delta_K(t)/(1-t)$.

items.title: Failure of Fox–Milnor factorization obstructs local sliceness

references.title: Ralph H. Fox and John W. Milnor, Singularities of 2-spheres in 4-space and cobordism of knots
Charles Livingston, A Survey of Classical Knot Concordance
references.locator: §3.3, printed p. 326: factorization as a necessary concordance obstruction.

items.statement: Assume the full Axiom of Choice. Let $K\subset S^3$ be a smooth oriented knot and let $\Delta_K(t)$ be its Alexander polynomial in the determinant normalization, with $p\doteq q$ meaning $p=\pm t^kq$ for some $k\in\mathbb Z$. If there is no Laurent polynomial $f(t)\in\mathbb Z[t^{\pm1}]$ such that $\Delta_K(t)\doteq f(t)f(t^{-1})$, then $K$ does not bound a locally flat properly embedded disk in the standard four-ball $B^4$. This is a necessary obstruction only; factorization alone does not assert sliceness.

items.title: A metabolizer forces Levine–Tristram signatures to vanish

references.title: Charles Livingston, A Survey of Classical Knot Concordance
references.locator: §3.1, printed pp. 325–326: a metabolic Seifert form has zero signature away from Alexander roots.

references.title: Anthony Conway, The Levine–Tristram Signature: A Survey
references.locator: §2.1 and Remark 2.10, printed pp. 3–5: Hermitian form convention, nonsingularity away from roots, and metabolic vanishing.

items.statement: Assume full AC. Let $K\subset S^3$ be a smooth oriented knot, let $F$ be a connected compact smooth oriented Seifert surface of genus $g$, and let $V$ be the positive-push Seifert matrix in an ordered integral basis. Suppose the integral Seifert lattice has a rank-$g$ direct summand $M$ on which $V$ vanishes identically. For every $\omega\in S^1\setminus\{1\}$ with $\Delta_K(\omega)\ne0$, the Levine–Tristram signature $\sigma_\omega(K)$ is zero. The assertion concerns only points away from Alexander roots; no value at a root is asserted here.

items.statement: Assume full AC. Let $T$ be the right-handed trefoil obtained by plumbing two positive Hopf bands, with positive-push Seifert matrix $V=\begin{pmatrix}-1&0\\-1&-1\end{pmatrix}$. Let $T^\dagger$ be its reverse mirror and set $S=T\#T^\dagger$. Then $S$ bounds a smooth proper disk in $B^4$ for which the squared radial function has only index-$0$ and index-$1$ interior critical points. A Seifert matrix for $S$ is $W=\operatorname{diag}(V,-V^T)$, the rank-$2$ direct summand $M=\langle e_1+e_4,e_2+e_3\rangle\subset\mathbb Z^4$ is a metabolizer for $W$, and $\Delta_S(t)\doteq (t^2-t+1)^2$. In particular, with $f(t)=t^2-t+1$, the determinant is a Laurent-unit multiple of $f(t)f(t^{-1})$.
